task: Manual evidence review of the six O3 source_hit_outside_episode_timing episodes only.

methodology.scope: Exactly the six O3 episodes labeled source_hit_outside_episode_timing in the source-discovery artifact. No no_source_hit_found episodes, no already-reviewed source_hit_exact_city episodes, and no O4/O5 or other universe were reviewed.
methodology.saved_evidence_first: The saved source hit(s) in the source-discovery artifact were used first for each target. Targeted external chronology was added only to resolve actual event timing and same-day episode attribution.
methodology.publication_time_rule: Publication/message/update time is not event time. A publication inside or near the target alert does not establish that the reported event occurred in that alert.
methodology.same_day_episode_rule: All alert episodes on each candidate date were compared. If the event timing better fits a different episode, the target is rejected and better_matching_episode_id is recorded.
methodology.strict_rule: confirmed_strict_miss requires exact-city Zaporizhzhia evidence, military/aerial-war explosion/strike/PVO context, and sufficiently resolved timing tying the event to the concrete target alert while excluding neighboring episodes.
methodology.sensitivity_rule: sensitivity_only is reserved for exact-city military evidence plausibly belonging to the target but lacking enough temporal specificity for strict.
methodology.rejection_rule: rejected is used when event timing excludes the target, or when evidence demonstrably belongs to another alert episode.
methodology.protected_scope: No canonical numerator/denominator, monitor, dashboard, Grafana, Netlify, production, or non-research artifact is modified by this pass.

outside_episode_timing_assessment.headline: All six retained hits described real exact-city military attack evidence, but none belonged to the target episode.
outside_episode_timing_assessment.dominant_mechanism: wrong-episode attribution on multi-episode dates, usually amplified by publication/update lag
publication_or_update_lag_examples: 2026-01-20: 18:35 update described an 18:08-18:24 attack in the preceding strict alert.
2026-03-11: 18:12 police publication described an attack timed to about 16:10 in the preceding strict alert.
2026-03-14: 17:23 police publication described four KAB strikes timed to about 15:30 in the preceding strict alert.
2026-05-26: 12:51 publication fell inside the target window but described an attack timed to about 11:40 in the preceding strict alert.
coarse_event_time_examples: 2026-02-10: no exact minute was recovered, but a 16:20 contemporaneous report explicitly says it was written in the first minutes after the explosion, excluding the target that ended at 15:40 and favoring the 15:57-19:25 strict alert.
2026-03-20: 'around one in the afternoon' is coarse, but still cleanly excludes the 09:28-10:59 target and falls within the 12:27-17:10 strict alert.

targeted_o3_followup_assessment.rationale: The exact-city batch plus this outside-timing batch exhaust the retained O3 source-hit episodes. This pass yielded zero new strict misses and showed that the outside-timing hits were all explainable by already-canonical-strict neighboring episodes. It therefore does not provide a new high-signal rule for expanding into the 313 no_source_hit_found episodes.
targeted_o3_followup_assessment.stop: Do not proceed to no_source_hit_found, O4/O5, canonical repair, or production changes.
